sample.rationale: The Metaphor Stretch names the general gap between physics and playability — 'the physics gives you the ratios but not absolute pitch, voice count, decay rate.' The Curve Is the Material is the fully worked-out account of exactly the half physics DOES determine (the curve/ratio family) — it deepens Metaphor Stretch's 'stretch' framework rather than standing apart from it.
